people.name: Sodom
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God for its sins

translations.web: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
translations.bsb: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, your sister Sodom and her daughters never did as you and your daughters have done.
translations.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
translations.asv: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
